hook: Leverage is easy. Not getting liquidated is the hard part.
body: When collateral declines, unmonitored positions risk falling into bad debt before a protocol can react. On Vanna, risk is bounded structurally. A priced account with debt must maintain a health factor strictly above 1.1 to be considered healthy. Once an account reaches or drops below 1.1, it becomes a liquidation candidate. It is marked as eligible for liquidation subject to oracle, configuration, funding, and execution checks to isolate the position before undercollateralization spreads.
